categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: aluminum processing, paper packaging materials, and functional films. These segments encompass the production and sales of aluminum foil, aluminum plates and strips, coated carbon foils, transfer paper, composite paper, high barrier films, conductive films, car protective films, and energy-saving films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technological innovation with advanced production equipment and proprietary technologies, holding numerous patents in aluminum foil manufacturing, conductive coatings, and composite film production. It employs order-based production, continuous batch procurement, and integrates research, development, production, and quality control to maintain high efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries in electronics (batteries, capacitors, printed circuit boards), food and beverage packaging, tobacco, pharmaceuticals, automotive, and construction. Major clients are companies like Guangzhou Hexin Paper, Tetra Pak, and Shenzhen Bolida Paper, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with strategic hubs in Shantou, Jiangsu, Anhui, Henan, and Sichuan provinces. It also has overseas operations through subsidiaries in Hong Kong. Sales are distributed across East China, Central China, Southwest China, South China, other domestic regions, and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on processing and manufacturing aluminum products, paper packaging materials, and functional films. It controls raw material procurement, production, and direct sales to downstream customers, integrating upstream and downstream activities within its industrial chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core business competitiveness, expanding high-value product lines such as high-standard battery aluminum foil and high-barrier films, and advancing industrial upgrades through R&D and acquisitions. The company invests heavily in innovation, with ongoing projects targeting ultra-thin aluminum foil, conductive coatings, degradable barrier films, and photovoltaic backsheet membranes, supported by a strong patent portfolio and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of aluminum processing products, paper packaging materials, and functional films. The company follows a direct sales model, fulfilling customer orders with invoicing upon delivery and acceptance. It also engages in trading activities and receives government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue sources.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in aluminum processing, paper packaging, and functional films, competing with other large-scale manufacturers with advanced technology and scale advantages. It faces competition from smaller firms with less mature technology and from international suppliers, focusing on product differentiation and scale to maintain market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved total operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.58 billion, a 22.52% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by growth in aluminum processing and paper packaging segments. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 192 million, reflecting challenges from raw material price volatility, increased financial expenses, and asset impairments. The company maintains total assets around RMB 10.28 billion with a stable but cautious growth outlook.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes technological innovation, product quality, and scale advantages to deliver high-performance, environmentally friendly, and high-value-added materials. Its product portfolio covers a broad range of applications with tailored solutions, including high-precision electronic aluminum foil, eco-friendly paper packaging, and advanced functional films for automotive and photovoltaic uses, differentiating through R&D capabilities, patent protection, and integrated supply chain management.
